overview_description.description: Basepilot provides AI-powered solutions designed to support insurance operations by automating claims processing and policy administration. The company develops custom AI workers that handle routine and repetitive tasks, allowing insurers, managing general agents, and brokers to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort. Its platform integrates with existing systems to manage data entry, document processing, and communication tasks, aiming to improve operational efficiency and consistency. It also offers tools to monitor AI performance and ensure compliance with insurance industry standards. The company focuses on delivering scalable AI solutions that adapt to the unique needs of each client’s business processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Basepilot provides custom AI workers to automate claims and policy administration for insurers, MGAs, and brokers.

product.name: Insurance AI Workers
product.description: Custom AI assistants designed to automate insurance operations such as claims processing, policy administration, quoting, and document handling for insurers, MGAs, and brokers.

product.name: Claims Processing Automation
product.description: Automates error-prone and time-consuming claims processes to reduce cycle time, minimize claims leakage, and improve accuracy.

product.name: Policy Lifecycle Administration Automation
product.description: Automates policy management tasks such as issuance, endorsements, cancellations, renewals, and bordereaux creation to improve operational efficiency.

product.name: Quotes and Applications Automation
product.description: Automates the generation of insurance quotes, applicant assessments, data entry, verification, and customer communication to speed up policy onboarding.

product.name: Document Processing and Generation Automation
product.description: Digitizes and automates document workflows including COI issuance, loss run reports, ACORD form processing, and claims document handling to reduce errors and processing time.
